fullTextEN: I am Xika.
I am Taiwanese.
How are you?
Welcome to lazy Chinese.

fullTextZH: 今天我们一起来台湾看看一个特别的东西。
fullTextEN: Today we come to Taiwan together to see something special.
Look at this person.

fullTextZH: 为什么他的嘴巴牙齿都是血呢？
fullTextEN: Why are his mouth and teeth all bloody?
Don't worry.
That's not blood.
His mouth and teeth are red,
because he eats something.
What he eats is called betel nut.
Betel nut is a kind of plant.
This is a betel nut tree.

fullTextZH: 这个绿色的小果子是槟榔。
fullTextEN: This small green fruit is betel nut.
It can be eaten.
Many Taiwanese people chew betel nut.
Especially drivers and people who drive.
People who drive for a long time.
Drivers or workers.
For example, construction workers.
They chew a lot of betel nuts.
Why is that?
Because after chewing betel nuts,
they don't feel tired.
They don't feel sleepy.
They can work continuously.
I have never chewed betel nuts.

fullTextZH: 我听说槟榔的味道辣辣的。
fullTextEN: I heard betel nuts taste spicy.
And also a bit sweet.
Now you take a look.
I have a box of betel nuts.
I have a box of betel nuts.
Let's open it and take a look.
This box has 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 7 betel nuts.
This box costs 50 yuan.
That's about 1.5 dollars.
Betel nuts are very hard.
They are not soft.
Very hard.
It smells a bit sweet.

fullTextZH: 吃槟榔的人都是这个味道。
fullTextEN: People who chew betel nut have this taste.
Should I eat it now?
I don't want to eat it.
I don't want to.

fullTextZH: 因为吃槟榔以后嘴巴会变红色的。
fullTextEN: Because after chewing betel nut, the mouth will turn red.
I don't want to.

fullTextZH: 在台湾有时候你会看到地上有红红的东西。
fullTextEN: In Taiwan, sometimes you will see red things on the ground.
This is betel nut juice.
Because chewing betel nut,
There will be betel nut juice in the mouth.
You can't swallow it.
Many people will spit it on the ground.

fullTextZH: 有时候你会看到这个东西。
fullTextEN: Sometimes you will see this thing.
This is betel nut residue.

fullTextZH: 槟榔咬一咬不可以吃下去。
fullTextEN: Chewing betel nut cannot be swallowed.
Many people will spit it on the ground.
Like chewing gum.

fullTextZH: 吃槟榔对嘴巴和牙齿很不好。
fullTextEN: Chewing betel nut is very bad for the mouth and teeth.
People who chew a lot of betel nut,

fullTextZH: 嘴巴和牙齿会变得不好看。
fullTextEN: The mouth and teeth will become unattractive.

fullTextZH: 嘴巴和牙齿会有很多问题。
fullTextEN: The mouth and teeth will have many problems.
You might get sick.

fullTextZH: 但是有些人吃很多槟榔，
fullTextEN: But some people eat a lot of betel nuts,
Because eating betel nuts can be addictive.
Once you eat the first one,
Hmm,
You'll want to eat the second one.
The third one, the fourth one.
You'll want to keep eating,
Eat a lot.
So do you want to eat?
Do you want to try?
If you want to buy betel nuts,

fullTextZH: 那你看看有没有这种招牌。
fullTextEN: Then see if there is this kind of sign.
This is the sign of a betel nut stall.
If you want to buy betel nuts,
Just go to a betel nut stall to buy.

fullTextZH: 在台湾有些槟榔摊有槟榔西施。
fullTextEN: In Taiwan, some betel nut stalls have betel nut beauties.
A beauty is a very beautiful woman.

fullTextZH: 槟榔西施就是卖槟榔的漂亮女生。
fullTextEN: Betel nut beauties are pretty girls who sell betel nuts.
They are very young,

fullTextZH: 穿漂亮的衣服或是穿很少的衣服。
fullTextEN: wearing pretty clothes or wearing very little clothing.

fullTextZH: 这样客人看到他们会想去买槟榔。
fullTextEN: This way, when customers see them, they will want to buy betel nuts.
They will want to buy a lot of betel nuts.

fullTextZH: 今天你认识了台湾的槟榔。
fullTextEN: Today you learned about Taiwan's betel nuts.

fullTextZH: 你想不想吃一个试试看呢？
fullTextEN: Do you want to try one?
You can try it,
but don't eat too many.
If you have eaten betel nuts,
tell me how it feels.
See you next time.
Bye bye.
